title: The recent enhancement of the surface melt over the Antarctic Peninsula dictated by thermodynamics
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 04 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76310-z

Antarctic Peninsula surface melt reversed its decline, significantly increasing 3% year-1 from 2009–2022. This intensified melt is dictated primarily (80%) by surface energy budget thermodynamics, rather than changes in atmospheric circulation.

title: Translational control by RPL22L1-specific ribosomes enhances DNA repair and chemoresistance
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 04 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76283-z

Ribosomal heterogeneity regulates the translation of specific mRNAs with unique structural features. Here, the authors discover that RPL22L1 regulates translation of mRNAs related to DNA repair such as ATRX, and that, consequently, RPL22L1 loss sensitizes cancer cells to chemotherapy.

title: Seismic evidence for lower-mantle heat supply beneath the Cordilleran slab window in western Canada
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 03 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76194-z

Using seismic imaging beneath the western Canada Cordillera, the authors show that an ancient gap left by a subducted oceanic ridge channels heat from deep within Earth, helping explain long-term uplift of the Canadian Cordillera.

title: Global vulnerability assessment of mobile telecommunications infrastructure to climate hazards using crowdsourced open data
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 03 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76197-w

Mobile networks face growing risks from climate hazards. The study finds that floods and tropical cyclones could affect millions of base stations worldwide and cause billions of dollars in damage.

title: Universal entanglement growth along imaginary time in quantum critical systems
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 03 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75645-x

Extracting universal entanglement features in higher-dimensional quantum critical systems has remained challenging. Here, the authors demonstrate a universal logarithmic scaling of corner entanglement in imaginary time, enabling efficient determination of critical properties from short-time dynamics.

title: Discovery of a covalent FGFR2-selective inhibitor overcoming clinically-acquired resistance mutations
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 03 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76339-0

This study reports the structure-based discovery of LC-F2-1, a selective FGFR2 inhibitor that overcomes clinically observed resistance mutations in cancers. Its co-crystal structure with FGFR2V565F reveals how it may restore drug sensitivity.
